description:
🚀 I'm a BS Artificial Intelligence student interested in AI, machine learning, and software development. I'm building a team for the NASA Space Apps Challenge to turn creative ideas into practical solutions.

I'm looking for passionate teammates skilled in programming, data analysis, space science, research, or UI/UX design. Most importantly, I value creativity, teamwork, and a problem-solving mindset.

Let's collaborate, learn, and build something impactful together! 🌍🚀me
